exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP及业务成功',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});const initial=b.data,form={};for(const k of ["name","fullName","industry","employeeSize","financingStage","companyNature","website","city","address","commuteDescription","description","foundedDate","legalRepresentative","registeredCapital","businessStatus","creditCode","registeredAddress","businessScope","workStartTime","workEndTime","restPolicy","overtimePolicy","benefits","workNotes","productName","productDescription","teamName","teamRole","teamBio","profileVersion"])form[k]=initial[k];let completed=0;const results=[];pm.collectionVariables.set('cpConcurrentExpectedVersion',initial.profileVersion+1);for(const text of ['并发保存甲','并发保存乙']){pm.sendRequest({url:pm.environment.get('cpHost')+'/company',method:'PUT',header:{'Content-Type':'application/json',Authorization:'Bearer '+pm.collectionVariables.get('cpToken1')},body:{mode:'raw',raw:JSON.stringify({...form,description:text})}},(err,res)=>{pm.test('并发请求可达',()=>pm.expect(err).eq(null));if(!err)results.push(res.json().code);completed++;if(completed===2){pm.test('同版本并发恰好一成一败',()=>pm.expect(results.sort()).deep.eq([200,500]));}});}
